scope: Python native function state encoding only; all Lean source inputs unchanged from the full graph candidate under independent audit.
changes: Require canonical string/None metadata and exact empty default/attribute/annotation containers.
Refuse deferred annotation evaluators, generic type parameters and noncanonical code constants without executing metadata hooks.
Detect code replacement by identity and retain primitive metadata mutation checks.
limitations: Python 3.14 deferred annotation regression is skipped on the installed Python 3.11 interpreter.
This correction does not establish hook-free handling of every arbitrary class or object in the base encoder.
Does not snapshot globals or mutable class namespaces.
post_validation_change: Module docstring narrows its hook-safety claim to the function-state implementation; executable code unchanged.
